{{Term/Store|Donkey|Donkeys|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''Donkey'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Donkey'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref> Donkeys go unnamed in {{MM}}.

==Characteristics==
==={{MM|-}}===
[[Cremia]] drives a Donkey to pull along her Carriage loaded with bottles of [[Milk]]. After defending [[Romani Ranch]] from the [[Ghost (Majora's Mask)|Ghosts]], [[Link]] can escort Cremia as she drives her Donkey through [[Milk Road]] to make her Milk delivery.

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Donkey}}
Donkeys are used as pack animals for traveling [[Merchant]]s throughout [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]].<ref name="Compendium">{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 162}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Smaller than horses, these are raised as livestock in the countryside, so they don't exist in the wild. They're more powerful than they look and specialize in transporting baggage. This has made them popular with traveling merchants.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> They can be found on the road with certain travelers or resting at [[Stable]] found throughout [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]]. This is because they are raised as livestock and therefore do not exist in the wild.<ref name="Compendium"/> Donkeys will always follow the Merchant that they are traveling with.

According to the traveling merchant [[Cambo]], the scientific name for Donkeys is ''equus donkus''.<ref>{{Cite|Oh, dear. You mean you weren't asking me to pontificate upon the charms of the equus donkus, as they are known?|Cambo|BotW}}</ref>
